exposure: Ultrasound-guided transvaginal aspiration of amniotic fluid and gestational tissue
Injection of 50 mg Methotrexate into the chorionic sac
Mechanical disruption of the sac with a needle
outcome: Resolution of Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP)
cohort: The study included 11 women diagnosed with Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy (CSEP) at Tawam Hospital (UAE).
finding: Ultrasound-guided transvaginal aspiration and local methotrexate injection followed by mechanical disruption showed a 100% success rate with no reported complications in treating Caesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 6.6 weeks (range 5-10 weeks)
